items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, accounting, human resources, or related field; or equivalent experience.
4-6 years Increasing responsibility and work experience in payroll, HR operations, accounting, or related administrative work.
4-6 years Experience supervising or leading staff, including performance management and workflow oversight, and training staff.
4-6 years Strong understanding of payroll processes, labor contracts, compensation rules, and HR policies.
4-6 years Ability to analyze complex data, identify discrepancies, and resolve issues with accuracy and timeliness.
4-6 years Strong communication and customer service skills; ability to explain payroll policies to staff, departments, and employees.
4-6 years Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive payroll and personnel information.

Covered Individuals: A Covered Individual includes anyone designated as Personnel or Students under this Policy who physically access a University Facility or Program in connection with their employment, appointment, or education/training. A person accessing a Healthcare Location as a patient, or an art, athletics, entertainment, or other publicly accessible venue at a Location as a member of the public, is not a Covered Individual.
